'''Moro Y'Arano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Genian]] who was [[Talesan Fry]]'s Executive in charge of business outreach at [[Fry Industries]]. At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Y'Arano was completely sealed off from the outside world in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. He took part in a meeting with a group led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had come to negotiate with the Fry Industries about the code breaker.<ref name="SOTJ" />
